newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower led by high caps.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower led by high caps.

text.p: Czech major issues plunged on Tuesday dragging the PX50 index down 2.7 perecent to 508 and causing consternation among some dealers about the speed of the decline among highly capitalised shares.
"I'm just amazed with the free fall that started this morning...Nobody wants to get long in anything," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.

The three most heavily capitalised shares all fell to year lows. SPT Telecom fell 191 crowns, 5.8 percent, to 3,054, power utility CEZ dropped 36 crowns, 3.8 percent, to 904 and Komercni Banka lost 72 crowns, 3.5 percent, to 2,000.
Dealers said the PX50 could easily fall further in the coming sessions as pessimism about company earnings and the macro-economic environment bites harder.
